findings.reason: the section must state that the station also records the project-wide reading an unscoped pane consults and that an ownerless pointer keeps every session's reading live, and add a control for it, or a pane settles while work it still prints is live.
findings.text: "a has-live-work reading per (project, session)" cannot express two members of the population set §10 itself cites: an unscoped follower's population is `session=None`, which `_population_has_live_work` reads as every non-terminal run in the project (`reckon/crew_follow_commands.py:1394`, :498-505), and a pointer with no recorded owner is counted live for every session, so a per-session reading leaves it attributable to no row; the new control varies only own-session against observed-session, so a reading that drops either case still passes the drain-settle test

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — verified against the tree: `resumption.sweep`, `recovery_review_acceptance.dispatch_awaiting_reviews`, `recovery_review_dispatch.review_settle_seconds_remaining` (:1258), `REVIEW_SETTLE_SECONDS` (:889), `_latest_resume_at` (:206), `resume_superseded_at` (:91), `dispatch_review_for_run` (:2454), `_check_settle` / `FOLLOWER_SETTLE_SAMPLE_SECONDS` (`crew_follow_commands.py`:1517, :312), `_population_has_live_work` (:482) and `settle_populations` (:1505) all resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — the drain-settle measure now carries a control for own-session-only, but no control exercises the unscoped population or an ownerless pointer, which the reading it replaces counts as live work.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §10's measures are a 60 s strace and test counts, and it declares no evidence path in a scratch or node-local directory.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §10's new prose names mechanisms (`settle_populations`, `_latest_resume_at`) and carries no plan labels, ticket numbers or changelog prose.
rubric_items.reasoning: the changed claim is accurate — the per-session reading the plan adds matches `settle_populations = (session, *sorted(observed_sessions - {None}))` and `_population_has_live_work`'s owner filter, and the advice-door settle statement now matches `_latest_resume_at` returning the newer of the two stamps — but the stated granularity does not cover all of a subscriber's populations (see the finding).
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §10's parts all serve one deliverable, moving the review reflex and settle detection out of every subscriber into the station once per node.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — s10 declares depends-on s7 and s8 (plan.html:23), the station and the subscriber its measure names, and s12 depends on s10.
